build_rnn_tower_lstm: build an RNN tower using LSTM cells with a specified number of layers and hidden size
build_rnn_tower_vanilla: build an RNN tower using VanillaRNN cells stacked via DeepRNN for sequence modeling
create_input_embedder_integration: create an RNN module that integrates an InputEmbedder to encode examples and labels before processing
run_rnn_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the RNN tower using static_unroll over the input sequence
review_rnn_model_type: review the RNN module to validate that model_type is either vanilla_rnn or lstm
